FileExportAllowed.title: FileExportAllowed
FileExportAllowed.description: Allow file exports, including filter files.

UserPreferencesSaveAllowed.title: UserPreferencesSaveAllowed
UserPreferencesSaveAllowed.description: Allow saving personal preferences and filters.

PolicyVersion.description: Policy contract version. Only version 1 is supported.

AllowedExportFormats.description: Allowed values. An empty list disables export.

DefaultExportFormat.description: Recommended default; a permitted personal choice takes precedence.

ForcedExportFormat.description: Required value; must be in the allowed list.

AllowedCompressionLevels.description: Allowed values. An empty list disables export.

DefaultCompression.description: Recommended default; a permitted personal choice takes precedence.

ForcedCompression.description: Required value; must be in the allowed list.

RedactionMode.description: Force redaction on or off, or allow user control. Required filters imply force-on.

RequiredBuiltinFilters.description: Required built-in filters, using their original matching semantics.

ManagedRedactionRules.description: Required custom filters. Maximum 400 combined managed and personal rules; enabled must be true. Runtime validates limits and Regex.

enabled.description: Must be true; enforced by the extension.

PreviewAllowed.title: PreviewAllowed
PreviewAllowed.description: Allow opening Preview & edit, including selection previews.

FilterSettingsAllowed.title: FilterSettingsAllowed
FilterSettingsAllowed.description: Allow opening Customize filter settings, including direct navigation.

DisabledBuiltinFilters.description: Built-in filter IDs that must be off. Must not overlap RequiredBuiltinFilters. Unlisted IDs keep their current behavior.

IncludePageTitle.description: Allow document titles. False excludes titles regardless of redaction.

IncludeFormValues.description: Allow current form values and selection states. False retains labels and structure.

PageUrlMode.description: Minimum exclusion of document URLs. A personal setting may be stricter.

LinkUrlMode.description: Minimum exclusion of structured link URLs.

LoggingLevel.description: Required local technical logging level. Managed debug continues until changed by the administrator.

LogMaxEvents.description: Upper retention limit for the local technical journal.

LogMaxBytes.description: Upper retention limit for the local technical journal.

LogMaxAgeHours.description: Upper retention limit for the local technical journal.

AllowedCaptureSources.description: Origin patterns: http://host, https://host, *://host; optional *. subdomains and :port or :*. Maximum 500 patterns. Deny takes priority. Empty allowlist blocks all external sources. Non-web and opaque sources are blocked when restrictions are active.

BlockedCaptureSources.description: Origin patterns: http://host, https://host, *://host; optional *. subdomains and :port or :*. Maximum 500 patterns. Deny takes priority. Empty allowlist blocks all external sources. Non-web and opaque sources are blocked when restrictions are active.

CaptureHistoryEnabled.description: Require capture metadata history on or off. Default is off when not configured.

CaptureHistorySettingsLocked.description: Prevent personal capture-history setting changes. Unspecified locked fields use defaults.

CaptureHistoryRetentionDays.description: Require history retention from 1 to 365 days. Default: 60.

CaptureHistoryMaxMiB.description: Require compact history JSON size limit from 1 to 50 MiB. Default: 10.

CaptureHistoryClearAllowed.description: Allow manual capture-history clearing. Default: true. Automatic retention still applies.

TechnicalLogClearAllowed.description: Allow manual technical-journal clearing. Default: true. Automatic retention still applies.

McpAllowed.description: Allow explicitly authorized external MCP connections. Does not enable MCP automatically.

McpSettingsLocked.description: Lock personal MCP connection and export settings. Stop and revoke remain available.

McpTestAllowed.description: Allow local MCP output tests, also subject to PreviewAllowed.

McpAllowedModes.description: Allowed MCP capabilities; an empty list denies all.

McpAllowedActions.description: Allowed MCP capabilities; an empty list denies all.

McpWriteApproval.description: Use each-action to require approval before every MCP action. If unset or session, users may choose bounded connection approval; the user default remains each-action.

McpAllowedClientIds.description: Additional MCP restriction; never expands general permissions.

McpAllowedCaptureSources.description: Additional MCP restriction; never expands general permissions.

McpBlockedCaptureSources.description: Additional MCP restriction; never expands general permissions.
